axes.concept: Lienzo e inspector: keep the decoration between its inputs and its engine result, within the existing Pictures shell.
axes.layout: Desktop three-pane workspace, 260px input / flexible scene / 270px inspector. Gallery uses filters / grouped results / preview. Home has an account fixture column and offset tool cards.
axes.navigation: Existing horizontal route navigation, tool cards at Inicio, in-page method buttons and quotation section anchors; Taller-local Decoraciones link.
axes.typography: Existing Geist Sans: 24px page title, 18–20px tool headings, 14–15px content, 12–13px metadata; 30px tabular count or total. Existing Geist Mono only for Sempertex.
axes.density: Permanent input and result panes at desktop; central illustration absorbs spare room. Tablet places the inspector below the workspace; phone stacks all panes with 20px insets.
axes.components: Real shadcn/Base UI Button and Input, Skeleton, Animate UI AlertDialog. Existing pill controls, paper panels and native account disclosure are rearranged around the scene; SVG scene is explicitly a fixture.
axes.colour: Exact Pictures globals.css and sibling contract tokens, including accessible control edges, both themes and Taller scene surface. Accent on primary action and illustrative balloon data; neutral route navigation.
axes.motion: Opposing lateral panel entrances (input −30px, inspector +36px), central 18px lift with .985 scale, 620ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); home 65ms stagger; quick 180ms hover/press. Motion profile drives shared numeral spring; reduced/still and hidden-tab parity.
